name: Admin Standalone Email Attachments
description: Admin attaches files to a standalone email from /panel/emails: multiple file input (.pdf/.doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx/.png/.jpg), client-side type and size validation via validateEmailAttachments (~/utils/emailAttachments), per-file remove button, and multipart POST /api/emails/send/ including the attachments. Documented as Branch B of admin-standalone-email-composer but never exercised by its spec.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 3): valid upload sent in multipart POST, type-validation rejection and per-file remove over mocked API.
